newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Treasury raises $33.2 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Treasury raises $33.2 mln in bonds.

text.p: Morocco's Treasury raised 315.9 million dirhams ($33.2 million) in bonds in June this year, compared with 512.5 million dirhams in the same month last year, the central bank, Bank al-Maghrib, said on Monday.
"Public subscription for bonds at between eight and nine percent interest rate raised 315.9 million dirhams," a bank spokesman told Reuters.
The bonds, valued at 5,000 ($526.3) and 50,000 dirhams, carried interest rates of eight percent for one year, 8.5 percent for three years and nine percent for five years.
Subscriptions were open from June 30 to July 3.
The central bank issues treasury bonds four times a year. The next issue will be in September.
The bank last week said it had cut interest rates on short and medium-term treasury bills by 0.5 percent to between 8.0 and 9.0 percent.
